extract_batch: mixed bytes and URL inputs share one output envelope

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, UrlExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind, UrlExtractionMode

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com"), ExtractInput(bytes=[66, 97, 116, 99, 104, 32, 98, 121, 116, 101, 115, 32, 99, 111, 110, 116, 101, 110, 116], filename="inline.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")]
    config = ExtractionConfig(url=UrlExtractionConfig(mode=UrlExtractionMode("document")))
    result = await extract_batch(inputs, config)
    print(result.results)
    print(result.results[0].content)
    print(result.results[1].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
